name: Navigate between the portfolio routes
covers: About, Reviews, Portfolio and Contact navigation
description: Checks that each navigation item opens the correct content and the review page has its dedicated URL.
steps: Select Reviews in the main navigation
expected: The Reviews page opens at /full-reviews, Portfolio shows the growth frameworks, and Contact shows the enquiry form.

name: Submit a complete store growth enquiry
covers: store URL and growth goal fields
description: Checks that a valid enquiry is prepared for the user's email application with store context.
steps: Enter a name and valid email
Enter a store URL and project context
expected: The browser opens an email draft addressed to hello@mubashelite.com containing the submitted store and goal details.

name: Review page protects testimonial authenticity
description: Checks the review route and ensures only verified feedback is represented.
expected: The /full-reviews page explains that only genuine, approved feedback will be published and shows no invented ratings.

name: Explore growth workstreams
description: Checks that the portfolio page presents the three growth workstreams and links visitors to an enquiry.
steps: Review the three growth framework cards
expected: Store conversion, organic discovery and lifecycle retention workstreams are visible, and the Contact page opens.
